question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Did you enjoy getting to vote for Homecoming?
options: I'd rather vote on something else.

nodes.text: And a couple hours later, Sara approaches her dad.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Can I go now?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You did the laundry?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Dried and folded everything! I put them in everyone's rooms.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And the kitchen floor?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So clean I'd eat off it.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What about the composting?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's all in the backyard, just waiting to waste away.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You can't have possibly done that `and` your training regimen...
nodes.text_bbcode: You can't have possibly done that [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] your training regimen...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's called multitasking, Dad.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Chores and training are easy when you divide the chores into reps like in weightlifting.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So can I go?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: There's even enough time for me to have a nice relaxing bath before Hannah and Linda get here!
Half an hour later, the doorbell rings! A freshly bathed Sara invites Hannah and Linda into her home.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hey, girls!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ready to get ready?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I brought over my makeup kit! We're going to look fantastic!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yay! Let's get started!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, I think I'm can hold it together...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm going to look weak if I lose my temper... And if there's one thing I can't stand, it's weakness.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I'm sorry you're upset, Taylor, but $ZOE is also our friend, so it seems weird not to support her, and...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I think I speak for all of us when I say that even though we voted for both you and $ZOE, we support you more.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, don't worry about it. That's fine. I can still win even if all of you were... Generous enough to also vote for $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And we'll definitely talk about it at cheerleading practice next week when I make you run laps until you faint!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard and I are... Fighting. But, look, can we not talk about it right now? I don't want to...
$ZOE feels tears well up in her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, of course. Don't ruin your mascara or anything.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know what happened, but it'll be okay.
Sam hugs her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope so...
And that's it for $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, what? What happened? You two went to lunch together, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, this is rich. You and Howard came separately? That can't mean anything good, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Get out of here, Taylor... Before I tear that blonde bun right off your overly hairsprayed head.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, I know when I'm not wanted.
Taylor leaves, and Sam turns to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She is so lucky I didn't tell her about that huge smear of lip gloss on her cheek. Either she's really bad at putting on makeup, or she made out with someone who has no idea how to kiss.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, what's going on?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Freshening up before his big debut as `Homecoming King.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Freshening up before his big debut as [color=#3b78e2][i]Homecoming King.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He told me he wanted to look his best before we emerge as the Homecoming Couple of the year.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah right... You don't know that you won.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't, but I have a good feeling about it. Just like that great feeling I have about that a huge smear of lip gloss on your cheek.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How did that even happen? Did Bryce miss your mouth by, like, a mile?
Taylor gasps and runs off to find a mirror. $ZOE sighs in relief.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE... What's really going on? Howard's not in the bathroom. He's a dude. Guys don't go there to 'freshen up'.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Truth.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was the best thing I could think of.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what's up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, I don't know why this is such a big deal.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You don't know why?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! I deleted his email, I'm not going to keep pursuing our friendship, what more do you want?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't you trust me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not when it comes to him!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, you're the one I want to be with.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You say that, but you wanted to be with him when you were in France! You kissed him!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was trying to move on! I never forgot about you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great, I'm `so glad` you were thinking about `me` when you were kissing `him!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Great, I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]so glad[/i][/color] you were thinking about [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] when you were kissing [color=#e23b3b][i]him![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Would it help if we hit this Matteo guy with a pillow?
Howard and $ZOE look over and see the twins staring sadly at them, pillows hanging limply at their side.
Kel holds the treasure box in her other hand.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I beat Kay to the treasure, $ZOE.
Kay holds the treasure box in her other hand.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I beat Kel to the treasure, Howard. Can't you be happy about that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm done with this. I'm going inside.
Howard drops his pillow and heads towards the house.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, wait! But what about the dance?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll see you there.
Howard slams the sliding glass door behind him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Twins. Looks like Howard and I should have talked before we played.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: That didn't sound like talking.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: It sounded like fighting.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah well... Raincheck on playing pirates, okay?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: $ZOE the Parrotless still hasn't found her parrot...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: $ZOE the Parrotless has other things to find right now... Next time.
$ZOE heads home.
At home, $ZOE buries her head in her pillow and cries and cries...
Until...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What time is it?
She pulls her head up to look at the clock.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Time to go to the dance...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All alone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Without Howard.
$ZOE puts on her dress, her makeup, and her shoes...
And heads out into the night...
The Homecoming Dance is in full swing by the time $ZOE arrives.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know where I'm supposed to go. Without Howard, who should I hang out with?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, there's Sam...
Sam and Spencer approach $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's up, cuz? I've been looking for you everywhere. You're nearly an hour late. And you look... Not as chipper as usual.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not everyone's happy all the time.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't get it, meathead. $ZOE's chipper about `everything.` If she's sad while the gym is decorated like this, something is wrong.
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't get it, meathead. $ZOE's chipper about [color=#3b78e2][i]everything.[/i][/color] If she's sad while the gym is decorated like this, something is wrong.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She's probably sad because she has no hope of winning Queen.
Sam and $ZOE spin around and see Taylor, smirking.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Butt out, Taylor. Just because no one voted for you doesn't mean you have to take it out on the rest of us.

nodes.text: Like you're one to talk. $ZOE, don't worry. I promise not to have too much fun while I'm on vacation with Howard.

$ZOE moves her pillow to block, but it is too slow!
Howard smacks $ZOE in the arm!

$ZOE lunges for the treasure!

nodes.text: Nice try, $ZOE... But you forgot about Howard Me Timbers!

nodes.text: You know, the moment the Queen is announced, you have to kiss her.

Howard and $ZOE both look down at her phone, neither moving.

nodes.text: Speak of the `devil...`

nodes.text: What does he want?

nodes.text: At that moment, the door to the backyard bursts open, and the twins come out!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hi, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Welcome back!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kay? Kel? What are you two doing out here?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We live here!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: `And` we're part of the surprise...

nodes.text: They were phase two of the tropical vacation. You see, Kay and Kel lent me the money to go to France to find you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll question the logistics of that later... But that was very sweet of you, Kay and Kel.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're the sweetest!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Like candy!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Anyway, in order to pay them back, I kind of promised that we'd play pirates when you returned...

nodes.speaker: Kay

nodes.speaker: Kay

nodes.text: $ZOE, we have to grab the box! You climb the slide! I'll take the ladder!
Kel barrels up the ladder. $ZOE sees the slide and jumps on it!

nodes.text: I'm glad you like it. I wasn't sure if you would.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And if you become Queen, then think of this as a pre-vacation.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're so sweet. Thanks for setting this all up...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least all I have to worry about now is the Homecoming Kiss...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It just reminds me of what's going to happen if I don't win. You alone with some other beautiful girl on an tropical island...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I was trying to make you feel better, not worse.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, going away doesn't mean I'll forget about you. You're the only one I will ever love.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And besides, I'm not interested in any of the other Homecoming Princesses...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, you see... I, uh, there are other people in the group...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `JESSICA, WHO DID YOU VOTE FOR?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]JESSICA, WHO DID YOU VOTE FOR?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You and $ZOE! You know, I only voted for both of you once, so it's not like I'm supporting $ZOE more than you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I want both of you to win equally, so I don't see why it's a `problem`...
nodes.text_bbcode: I want both of you to win equally, so I don't see why it's a [color=#3b78e2][i]problem[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You want to know what the problem is?! It's called the Triple Crown, Jessica! Not the `Two-and-a-Half Crown!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You want to know what the problem is?! It's called the Triple Crown, Jessica! Not the [color=#3b78e2][i]Two-and-a-Half Crown![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You're being a little scary...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Taylor has her witch face on...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Shh, Amanda... Don't draw attention... Maybe she'll forget we're here...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, you know what? This is fine. I can still win even if all of you were `traitorous` enough to also vote for $ZOE!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, you know what? This is fine. I can still win even if all of you were [color=#3b78e2][i]traitorous[/i][/color] enough to also vote for $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And we'll definitely talk about it at cheerleading practice next week when I make you build the pyramid until you fall over!
Taylor shoves her phone in her purse and climbs back into the car.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Drive on.
The limo starts.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So, uh... What happened to Bryce?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, nothing.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Did he, uh, stand you up?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Didn't I just say it was `nothing?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Didn't I just say it was [color=#3b78e2][i]nothing?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Geez, sorry, Taylor. It's just, I think everyone is expecting you to have a date to the dance, and like, you don't.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thank you, Jessica. Maybe I should just take your date.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I couldn't do that to Jessica...
Jessica leans over and whispers to Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just between us... You can take him.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, stop. Just stop talking.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But what are you going to do? You can't show up at the dance without a date... It'll look like you're single and desperate!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: First, shut up. Being single doesn't make me desperate.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Second, you're wrong. Homecoming is the only dance you can go to without a date!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Besides, a Homecoming Queen doesn't need a date when she's with her Homecoming King.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I totally agree with you, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What did I say about `talking?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What did I say about [color=#3b78e2][i]talking?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Not to do it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thank you, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love the Quiet Game!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: { La dee da... Being so quiet... {

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Saying that you're being quiet doesn't count as being quiet!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That's why I always lose...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: So does the 'No talking' thing apply to boys?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It applies to everyone, Jacob! So shut up. I need to sit `in peace and quiet` until we get to the dance.
nodes.text_bbcode: It applies to everyone, Jacob! So shut up. I need to sit [color=#3b78e2][i]in peace and quiet[/i][/color] until we get to the dance.

nodes.text: The limo rumbles on, its passengers scared into silence by Taylor's foreboding glare.
At the Homecoming Dance, Taylor and the rest of the popular kids congregate.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is the Quiet Game over yet?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, Amanda. Go ahead. Talk.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whee! Everyone is so pretty! I like the limo! Now we're at the dance! Look at the lights! I love everything!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Seriously, what is wrong with you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, that's what happens when you don't let Amanda talk... She bottles it all up, and then it explodes out later.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hello punchbowl! Hello bandstand! Hello Homecoming! Can we dance? The best part about a dance is dancing!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Speaking of which... Should we go hit the dance floor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No way! I can't get look all gross and sweaty when I'm on stage, becoming Queen!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You can dance at every dance. Homecoming is the only one where you can get crowned.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Do you think you're going to win?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course I am. You all voted for me, didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I voted for you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's what I like to hear...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And I voted for $ZOE too!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But you can't vote twice!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sure you can.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Did `all` of you vote for $ZOE too?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Did [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] of you vote for $ZOE too?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I, uh... Well, I did.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You what? You... I can't believe...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't lose it! Must stay calm... Must... Stay... Calm...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Sure, if you say so. We had our fun. Thanks for hanging out, but let's not do this again.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks a `whole` bunch. That doesn't help with this whole 'I-have-no-date-for-the-dance' thing!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, thanks a [color=#3b78e2][i]whole[/i][/color] bunch. That doesn't help with this whole 'I-have-no-date-for-the-dance' thing!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: And this just makes me glad I'm not in high school anymore. No one cares about lame dances in college.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Besides, like I said, you're hot and popular. You can pull a guy out of thin air, right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, I wouldn't be Taylor Vale if I couldn't, would I?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Exactly. Now I... I have to go.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Right. Just. Great.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm going to make you regret the day you were born! You won't forget what you've done for the rest of your life!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You haven't heard the last of `Taylor Vale!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You haven't heard the last of [color=#3b78e2][i]Taylor Vale![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Uh... I was hoping you'd take this better...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How can I? You just ditched me on the night I'm supposed to be out winning my third crown!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: See, it's stuff like this that makes me glad I'm not in high school anymore... No one cares about lame dances in college.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Bryce, this is more than just a lame dance! `This is my life!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Bryce, this is more than just a lame dance! [color=#3b78e2][i]This is my life![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Whoa, okay. I don't really have time to deal with drama like this. Look, Taylor, I... I have to go.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I hope you die alone, you slimy jerk!
Taylor ends the call.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great. Now I'm dateless, `and` I've made a fool out of myself!
nodes.text_bbcode: Great. Now I'm dateless, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] I've made a fool out of myself!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He's hot, I'm happy.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: But do you even get along?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You don't have to worry about getting along when you're popular. Let me tell you a little bit about how the world works.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There are popular girls and then there are other girls. Popular girls have all the boys, all the power, and all the respect. Other girls don't.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You understand me?

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Sure. You get all the best things being popular. But what do you get to do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You get to be in the spotlight! Everyone stares at you, gets out of your way, and lets you do whatever you want!

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: But doesn't that get a little boring?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What do you know? You'll get it when you're older, I'm sure.
There's a honk outside the house!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There they are!

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Have fun...
Taylor runs outside and into the stretch limo, where all the cheerleaders and their dates are waiting.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Taylor, you're here!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course I'm here. You're in front of my house, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Of course, but, uh, we have to tell you something...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's with the sad faces? You're supposed to be happy. It's going to be my crowning moment! Literally!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait a minute, where is Bryce?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's what we wanted to tell you...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: We guess he's not coming...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `WHAT?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]WHAT?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We tried to pick him up at his house, but no one answered and...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `STOP. THE. CAR.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]STOP. THE. CAR.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The limo pulls to a stop, and Taylor climbs out, pulling her phone out of her purse. She dials Bryce's number.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hey there, Bryce here.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Bryce.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Bryce.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Oh, Taylor, hey. How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Can you explain to me `why` you're not `here` in Centerscore taking `me` to a dance?
nodes.text_bbcode: Can you explain to me [color=#3b78e2][i]why[/i][/color] you're not [color=#3b78e2][i]here[/i][/color] in Centerscore taking [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] to a dance?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Oh, man, I totally forgot... That's tonight?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Yes, it's tonight!` When can you get here?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yes, it's tonight![/i][/color] When can you get here?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Sorry, I can't.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: MAN fraternity's having a sorority mixer with OMG, and well, you know how it goes. Have to fulfill some MAN-ly duties.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And some `fraternity party` is just `so much more important` than `my` Homecoming Dance?!
nodes.text_bbcode: And some [color=#3b78e2][i]fraternity party[/i][/color] is just [color=#3b78e2][i]so much more important[/i][/color] than [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] Homecoming Dance?!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Well, yeah. They're counting on me to be there.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, `I` was counting on `you` to be `here!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] was counting on [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] to be [color=#3b78e2][i]here![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you get ready and drive from Centerscore U, you can get here in... Thirty minutes? That's plenty of time...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Taylor, I'm sorry, but I can't make it. And you know, this just isn't working out.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You're popular and hot... I'm popular and hot... Together we looked great and had a lot of good times...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: But to be honest, I'm in college now. I have other college-y things to do.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Bryce...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Bryce...[/i][/color]

options.label: You're going to pay for this!

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: What does that word mean?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It means you're innocent. You don't know the first thing about love.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: I know when two people are dating, it means they like each other.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Or at least, they `should.` Otherwise it's not good, right? Right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Or at least, they [color=#e23b3b][i]should.[/i][/color] Otherwise it's not good, right? Right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Maybe you're smarter than I thought.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But that's not how all relationships work...

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: All I know is that if you like someone so much that you're dating him, I really want to meet him!

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: I have to see if he's really making you happy!

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: So I've been told.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: But why are you calling me that now?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let me explain something to you. Sometimes, people who are dating aren't in love. Sometimes they don't even like each other.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: But then why would they date? Do you not like Bryce? Are you not happy with him?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Being in a relationship with Prissy taught me a lot.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I thought she was my girlfriend. I would ask her out on dates, and she'd say things like, 'I can't, Erik, I have to wash my hair.'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Or 'I can't, I have `another` dentist appointment!'
nodes.text_bbcode: Or 'I can't, I have [color=#e23b3b][i]another[/i][/color] dentist appointment!'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Or 'I can't go out tonight, Erik, I have to babysit my cousin's giraffe...'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And then I realized, she's not my girlfriend because she never actually said so!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's okay! I had fun. I'm just happy that I'm now hanging out with the winning candidate!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I haven't won though...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not yet, you mean! You're the coolest candidate around!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Aww, thanks...
Sara and Erik find Hannah and Linda on the sidelines.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So what does one do at a dance? Other than, you know, `dance.`
nodes.text_bbcode: So what does one do at a dance? Other than, you know, [color=#3b78e2][i]dance.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, it's usually just hanging out, eating a couple snacks, gossiping about everyone's dresses...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: When are they going to announce Homecoming Queen?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Soon, I think. I can't wait to see if you win!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Do you know what you're going to say when you get your crown?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: If I get the crown, it'll be one of the best days of my life, and I have you and Linda to thank for everything.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And if I don't win... I'm just glad that I got to spend this night with all of you...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aww...
And that's it for Sara...
It's almost time for Taylor to leave for the Homecoming Dance, and she's putting the finishing touches on her makeup.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A little swipe of passion fruit eye shadow, plum eyeliner for contrast...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Some red apple lip gloss, and I'm ready to go!

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: All those sound delicious, Sis!
Taylor sees Elmo at her elbow and sighs.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's makeup, not food. Just because you still wear your dinner on your face sometimes doesn't mean I do.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: I'm learning how to use the spoon right, but it's hard!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know, kiddo, I know.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: So if you're putting makeup on, are you going out?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Elmo, are we even related? How can you not know that tonight is the Homecoming Dance? Everything I've worked for has been leading up to this...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Tonight is the night I win my `Triple Crown.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Tonight is the night I win my [color=#3b78e2][i]Triple Crown.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll win!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thank you for your vote of confidence. Of course I'm going to win, and I'm going to be standing up there next to the Homecoming King, and every student at that school will remember my name for years to come.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Is the Homecoming King your boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's funny, but no, he's not. In fact he's another Princess's boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Won't she be upset if you win instead?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I hope so...

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Lighten up, little brother. I'm sure she'll live.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Oh, okay. But if the Homecoming King isn't your boyfriend, who's your date to the dance?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Bryce.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $USR's friend, Bryce. A college guy. He and the rest of the cheerleaders are going to pick me up soon, which is why I need to be absolutely ready.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Do I get to meet him?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't see why you would want to.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: But he's your date. Aren't you two in love?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Elmo, you are way too...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yay! I get a dance date with a Homecoming Princess! This is the best night ever!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Did he say 'date'?
Erik takes Sara into the middle of the room and starts dancing, his feet moving in short, jerky motions and his hands making wild gesticulations.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh... I don't think I know that dance move.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, Earthlings wouldn't. I learned all my dance moves from aliens!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Ha ha ha...
They dance until the song ends.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Want to dance another one?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh, sure... But you do know that this isn't a date, right?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I already know that!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I never assume anything after Prissy! Assuming makes a fool out of me!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Prissy taught me that two people aren't dating until `both` people say they are.
nodes.text_bbcode: Prissy taught me that two people aren't dating until [color=#e23b3b][i]both[/i][/color] people say they are.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No, don't take it the wrong way! I just thought...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, we're not dating, so I figured it might be a little weird...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, it's all right. I didn't know you had to be dating to dance together, so I assumed I could ask you.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But assuming only makes a fool out of me!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Prissy was always telling me I jumped to conclusions.
And a couple hours later...
Coach Kessler ventures into the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Sara? Sara? Where are you?
Sara climbs in from the garden.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sorry, I just finished sweeping the lawn.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You swept the lawn? What about the kitchen floor?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Don't worry, I weeded it.
Coach Kessler looks down at clumps of grass strewn on the floor.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I may have gotten a little confused.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And the laundry?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I put it in when I started eating lunch... And forgot to take them back out again.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Sara, remember our deal...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I know, Dad! I'll get everything done before I even think about getting ready for the dance. I'll fix this.
Half an hour later, the doorbell rings, and Hannah and Linda come in.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sara? You ready?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No, just give me a little more time... You girls can get started in my room... I'll be up in a bit!
And a hour later, Sara stumbles upstairs where Hannah and Linda are already coiffed and dressed.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm done...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Finally! I was worried we wouldn't even be able to get you out the door!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It'll take a little bit of work, but we can make you look decent.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Besides, remember why I'm at Centerscore in the first place?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I believe you told me it was for their superior academic program.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Right, but... Before I also said that it was because I wanted to be more than just a swimmer.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I want to be a `winner`, not just in the pool, but in all aspects of life.
nodes.text_bbcode: I want to be a [color=#3b78e2][i]winner[/i][/color], not just in the pool, but in all aspects of life.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: But what about your Saturday afternoon training regimen?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And don't think I've forgotten that you offered to do Emily's chores since she's off with your mother in New York.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I have a couple hours until I have to get ready, Dad. I'll do everything before the dance!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Okay.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You can go to the dance. But only as long as you're home by ten, and you do everything you need to get done today.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You're really letting me go?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's what I said, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thanks, Dad! Thank you so much!
Sara hugs him then starts running upstairs.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Wait, where are you going? Didn't you hear the part about your chores?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm going to do everything! But first I have to call Hannah! I love you, Dad!
Sara leans over the banister and kisses her dad's cheek.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: But one last thing!
Sara turns and looks at her dad questioningly.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Can we keep this a secret from your sister? I don't want her to get any ideas.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Whatever you say, Dad!
Sara runs up to her room.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Kids...
In her room, Sara calls Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I have good news and bad news. Good news is... I told my dad. He's letting me go to the dance!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Whee! Linda and I will be over at four to get ready!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, there's the bad news. I have to do all my chores and my workout before the dance, or I'm not going to be able to go.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Aw, come on. That's it? It'll be easy.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I wouldn't say it's easy... I don't have much time to get everything done.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Uh, hello? It's called multi-tasking! Doing multiple things at once! I'm doing it now! I'm painting my nails, eating a burrito, and driving at the same time!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That doesn't seem safe.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: But it's efficient!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: So I'll see you at four then! Work hard `and` clean hard!
nodes.text_bbcode: So I'll see you at four then! Work hard [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] clean hard!

nodes.text: Sara hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: All right, Sara. You have squats, shoulder presses, and abs workout...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And you have to do the laundry, sweep the floors, and weed the garden...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: All you have to do is multi-task!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And how exactly is being a dance princess going to help you?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Dad, a dance is part of being a high-schooler, and being Princess is something that not many girls get to be. I want to be able to experience life.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And you can experience many things in life that aren't a dance...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Like pushing your body to its limits, getting a low time on your backstroke, walking onto the first place platform...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Getting the gold medal at the Olympics.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Dad, going out for one night isn't going to prevent me from getting all that...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And this is an exciting opportunity for me.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And how exactly is going to Homecoming helping Emily out?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm her big sister. I should be the one testing things out for her, living life for her.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I believe your sister lives her own life and will make her own decisions.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: There isn't a boy in the picture is there?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No, it's not like that at all.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: It feels like you're not being entirely truthful...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Okay... Saying it was for Emily's good wasn't the best way to put it.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I really want to go to this dance, not for any boy or for anyone else but for me.
They head over to $ZOE...
And that's it for Sam's story!
It's five in the morning on the day of the Homecoming Dance, and the swim team is practicing hard...
In the swim lanes, the girls kick back and forth across the water on kickboards. Hannah kicks next to Sara's lane to talk.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I can't believe your dad's making us train on the day of the dance! Doesn't he know we girls have to prepare?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, he doesn't actually know about the dance.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What? But you told him you're a Homecoming Princess, didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You didn't?! Sara, I thought you were going to tell him!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: The topic hasn't really come up...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: So what are you going to do? Sneak out like you did for the Homecoming Parade?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No, I don't want to do that again. I hate lying to him.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, you haven't tried talking to him. Maybe telling him isn't going to be that bad. What's the worst that can happen?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Jane! I want to see more explosiveness! You're a butterfly, not a sea slug!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Grrr....

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, hopefully, it won't be `too` bad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, hopefully, it won't be [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] bad.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, right.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Call me when you tell him so we can get you ready for the dance in time!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Easier said than done.
A couple hours later, after practice...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And that's a wrap, girls! Get some rest! See you tomorrow, bright and early!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But, Coach, there's a dance tonight...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Then you'd better make it home in time to rest up.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aww...
Back at the Kessler house...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Can you believe those girls? Wanting me to push back practice for a dance?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, it makes sense...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I understand that a dance is fun, but it's not going to win you any medals for swim finals, that's for sure.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No, but... Dad, I want to go.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I know what you're thinking, Dad. Dances are frivolous, and they're not going to get me that far in life...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I want to go. I've been voted one of the Homecoming Princesses...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You have?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yes, and they're going to announce the winner tonight. Can I please go? I want to do this for...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And for being you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's what I'm good at.
Sam spots $ZOE at the door and points her out to Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, look, there's $ZOE. Let's talk to her for a few minutes before they announce Homecoming Queen.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What did you call me?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know I'm not him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm so sorry. Old habits...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I meant 'Spencer'. Thank you, Spencer. For keeping your eye on me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe I almost called him Colt! I'm glad I didn't say anything!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nothing. I wanted to say 'thank you', Spencer. For keeping your eye on me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm beginning to regret this already...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha ha.
At that moment, the waiter approaches their table.

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: All right. What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know, we didn't really talk about that...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What should we get?

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Ugh, do I have to come back?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What kind of attitude is that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, really. Don't be such a... A...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Jerkface?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hee hee! He `is` a jerkface...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hee hee! He [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] a jerkface...

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Are you going to order or insult me?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ordering is happening. Insulting is included.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Anyway, I usually get the...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Large Meat-lover's special?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, how'd you guess?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's just the one I wanted.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: One large Meat-lover's special... Coming right up...
The waiter walks away.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's totally going to spit in our food.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not if I spit in his face first.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He'd probably deserve it.
And for the rest of the dinner, Sam and Spencer talk...
At the dance...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So... What do you do at these things?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: At dances? Just hang out. Listen to the music in the background.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess this one's kind of special because they're making the Homecoming Queen announcements.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh yeah, when is that happening?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know. Hopefully soon.
Sam and Spencer sit with the jocks. Sam overhears the last part of their conversation.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Can you believe that Ben guy is a Homecoming Prince? What a dweeb! I should've at least been `nominated.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Can you believe that Ben guy is a Homecoming Prince? What a dweeb! I should've at least been [color=#e23b3b][i]nominated.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We can't all be Princes.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Well, that kid can't be a Prince `and` get to have a hot date. Isn't that the chick from the Prom afterparty?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that kid can't be a Prince [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] get to have a hot date. Isn't that the chick from the Prom afterparty?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah, it is. She looks good. What's her name again?
Sam and the football guys look over. On Ben's arm is Denni, wearing another stunning party dress.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? Since when did Denni become so attractive?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: First Colt, now the jock guys... Ugh!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I was thinking the same thing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you agree with them?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Agree with them?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You just said you think the same thing. Denni is dating Ben, and suddenly, she's gotten all 'hot'.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know you're into hot girls, but I didn't realize you'd get so easily distracted.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No! I was agreeing with you. I haven't looked her way at all.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And I am into hot girls! Which is why I've kept my eye on you the entire night.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess that's the best one out of the bunch.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'd almost rather be called 'Sammy'!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right, Samwich...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess that's the best one out of the bunch.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'd almost rather be called 'Sammy'!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right, Samface...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, sorry, I shouldn't be talking about my ex.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's cool.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I am sorry. I haven't been on a date with anyone since Colt, and... I'll have to get used to seeing that you're not him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right. Let's start over, Sammy.
Sam winces.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's what Colt used to call me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Then I guess we need a new nickname for you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right, what do you have?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What do you want to be called?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no, you have to come up with this part.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, what about 'babe' or 'girl'?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not really original.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: 'Teddy-bear'? 'Sweetheart'?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can we try to stay away from the cutesy love names?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: 'Sammy' is sounding pretty good...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Any `other` ones?
nodes.text_bbcode: Any [color=#3b78e2][i]other[/i][/color] ones?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sam... Face?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Samface? You came up with `Samface?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Samface? You came up with [color=#3b78e2][i]Samface?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're Sam, and you have a face, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't argue with that...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I got it! `Samwich!` You put the Sam in 'sandwich'!
nodes.text_bbcode: I got it! [color=#e23b3b][i]Samwich![/i][/color] You put the Sam in 'sandwich'!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's all I got.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right, call me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So why'd you ask me out?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're hot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not normally what a girl likes to hear.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Girls don't like to hear that they're hot?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, of course they do, but girls also like to hear that you like them for who they are.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah sure, but I asked you out because you're hot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ah. That's... Great.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt asked me out because we had something in common...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Did I say something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No. That's the truth, isn't it? That's good enough. If you were Colt, you'd probably...
Sam stops.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So why is this whole Queen thing important? Who cares what people think?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know, not many people have asked me that. I don't want to be Queen for somebody else. I want it for me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I had the chance to be one when I was at my old school, Monarch Prep, and I gave it all up.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For Colt. He convinced me it really wasn't my world or my place, and I didn't do it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, I can't believe I admitted that to Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe it is time... Maybe Colt being away is what I need to be different...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And that's why this is important to me... To take a risk and see if it pays off...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't know if you'll win...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did you vote for me?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No. I'm not the school spirit type.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Says the guy who won our Homecoming Game.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay, maybe I'm still getting used to it. So I roughed up a few guys for the team... It doesn't mean I'm going to go `vote.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, maybe I'm still getting used to it. So I roughed up a few guys for the team... It doesn't mean I'm going to go [color=#e23b3b][i]vote.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But if you don't win, I will punch anyone you want me to.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Anyone, no questions asked. If that'll make you feel better.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha. You don't have to do that.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No, seriously.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just don't get into trouble. Colt used to...
Sam stops.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shall we head out?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah.
At the restaurant Oven Brick-a-Brac Pizza...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This restaurant looks familiar, but I don't think I've ever seen this pizza place.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, it's good. This is where I get pizza on football nights.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Football nights?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, every Monday night.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Even though I was a cheerleader, I barely know when football season is, much less what day it shows.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha. I guess they show football on the weekends too, but Monday is the night my dad and I watch. So we get pizza from here all the time. It's not some fancy-schmancy place, but it's good.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, I'm not judging. I like pizza.
As they wait for a waiter, Sam and Spencer look at each other.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So what do you want to talk about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know. You could ask me something.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Or `you` could ask `me` something. What will it be? You or me?
nodes.text_bbcode: Or [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] could ask [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] something. What will it be? You or me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hmm...
Sam curls the last strand of hair into place! She arranges her hair.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Perfect! Take that, $ZOE! I can do this by myself.
She gathers her things and sits on her bed.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I do hope Colt is okay though... I still remember our first date on the back of his motorcycle...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And having to do my hair when I got back to the dorm so Whitford wouldn't catch me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That seems like such a long time ago...
The doorbell interrupts her thoughts.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I remember going on my first date with Colt... On the back of his motorcycle...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And having to do my hair when I got back so Whitford wouldn't catch me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I used to be so happy with Colt... What happened? And where is he right now?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And what is that burning smell?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `My hair!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]My hair![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam sets the curling iron down and tosses water on her hair!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I have to focus! I wonder if I have enough time to...
The doorbell rings...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess I'll just go with straight hair tonight...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Straight and vaguely burned.
Sam answers the door. Spencer stands on the porch, holding a box of flowers. He offers it to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt brought me flowers on our first date...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: These are for you. And, uh, you look nice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, thanks?
Four princesses... But only one can be Queen. See how each girl prepares for the big dance!
Which Homecoming Princess do you want to follow first?
It's almost dinnertime on the night of the Homecoming Dance.
Sam is just getting ready to curl her hair when her mom comes into the room.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Samantha? Can I come in?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I wanted to see how you were doing. Oh, your dress is so beautiful!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Your date's going to be so impressed. I can't wait to meet him! You must be so excited.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: ...What's wrong, sweetheart? Are you nervous?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sort of. Maybe a little. I mean, this Spencer guy is kinda cute, but...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Never mind. You wouldn't approve.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You're thinking about Colt, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I am. I can't believe I haven't heard from him! Not a word. Not even a freakin' letter!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I can't help wondering where he is or when he's coming back.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Samantha, I don't think he's ever going to come back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know, but I keep thinking about him. And this date with Spencer makes me think about him more!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, Sam, you can't go into a date obsessing over Colt.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Focus on your date with Spencer. It'll be good for you. It's time to move on, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: At least try to give this date your best shot?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. I'll try.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Would you mind if I just get ready for the dance alone? I want time to think.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Of course, dear. Just let me know if you need anything.
Sam's mom leaves the room, shutting the door gently behind her. Sam picks up her curling iron and stares at it angrily.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Stupid $ZOE, leaving for Howard's house... She knows I don't know anything about curling!
Sam has just gotten a strand of hair on her curling iron when her phone rings! She grabs it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sam? It's Denni. I have some news for you... It's about Colt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did you find him? Did you see him? Is he okay?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I didn't actually see him, but my uncle did. Apparently, the name 'Colt' came up on his police scanner or whatever.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, police scanner? Is he in some kind of trouble?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I... I'm sorry, but I don't know. All my uncle said was that he would take care of it, but... I don't have anything more than that.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I just wanted you to know. I can call you back when I know more.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure. I'll, uh, talk to you later then.
Sam hangs up and tosses her phone on her bed with her purse. She turns back to the mirror and absently twirls a strand of hair in her curling iron.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, you idiot, I hope you're okay.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Even if we're not together, I still...
Sam suddenly smells the scent of slightly singed hair.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If I'm going to save my hair, I'd better concentrate on curling, not on Colt...

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I can't believe I didn't win!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is just like my dream...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard probably enjoyed that kiss, and he

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Something's going to happen between them and... and...
$ZOE flees the gym, trying not to cry.
Outside, she leans up against a wall and sobs into her hands.
In her pocket, her phone buzzes, reminding her of Matteo's text. She pulls it out and reads it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Signorina, did you get my email? Know that I am thinking of you.'
In the dark quiet outside the gym, $ZOE wonders if she should reply...
Elsewhere, Sam slumps against Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...I didn't win.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess I was expecting too much.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I thought I could win... I was so close last time I tried, but maybe I should've done things a little differently.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not the kind of guy that's into this Homecoming thing, but...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I know you really wanted to win.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So I'll punch anyone you want. In fact, I'll punch everyone if that'll make you feel better.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha, thanks, Spencer, but you don't have to do that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Want to go somewhere and make out?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, yeah!
Some of the cheerleaders come up to Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sorry that you didn't win...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We really did vote for you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That didn't seem to help, did it? I had the votes, the talent, the popularity... What happened?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Maybe if you'd been a little nicer?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What was that?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Eep! Nothing!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Better. Now go dance or something. Having you around is depressing.
The cheerleaders leave, and Taylor leans against the wall and sighs. Brendan sits down in a chair close to her.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry you didn't win. Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know, I thought losing would devastate me, and instead, I just feel...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Relieved.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Really? I thought the Triple Crown meant everything to you...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It does... Or at least, it used to... I guess, maybe after this evening, it doesn't matter as much.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Even though I lost the crown today...
Taylor meets Brendan's gaze.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I feel like I've gained something better instead.
Back on the dance floor, Sara dances with Erik and sighs.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm sorry you didn't win, Sara.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But you'll always be queen of my heart!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That's so sweet, Erik. Thank you!
Sara kisses Erik on the cheek. As she pulls back, she notices her dad standing near her.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Dad! What are you doing here? It's not ten yet, is it?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: No, not yet. Mind if I take the next dance?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, sir! I'm just going to go right over there...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: ...You don't get out much, do you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, sir!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sara, I will find you later...
On a corner of the dance floor, Coach Kessler dances with his daughter.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I didn't know you were coming to the dance.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I couldn't miss my daughter getting crowned Homecoming Queen, could I?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, I didn't exactly get crowned...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's exactly why I didn't want you to come to this dance. I didn't want you to be disappointed.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I didn't want you to get hurt.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Are you kidding? This was fun! And it didn't deter me. I got elected Homecoming Princess this year, and I only knew a handful of people.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Next year, I'm going to know more people, right? So next year, I'll definitely have a chance!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: But your training...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Can still go on. I don't have to be just a swimmer or just a girl, Dad. I can be both.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And maybe next year, I'll definitely win that crown!

nodes.text: At that moment, the band stops playing, and the spotlights turn to the stage where Justin stands!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Good evening, everyone! At last, it's the time you've all been waiting for...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The announcement of our Homecoming Queen!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But first let's bring up our Homecoming King, Howard!
From behind the curtain, Howard walks to the center of the stage. Applause sounds throughout the dance hall.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wow, he's like the most depressing King ever.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Worse than King George IV? I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah, that's just sad...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: He may look down now, but not when he finds out the identity of his Queen!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Homecoming Princesses, if you'd please come on stage...
$ZOE, Sam, Sara, and Taylor ascend the stairs and stand in a row in the middle.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm happy to announce that this year's Homecoming Queen is...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So what dress are you wearing?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I was, uh, just going to wear something that was in my closet.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Uh-oh...
Sara looks inside her closet and fishes out the only party dress she has. It's long and bright green...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Isn't that the same color as your swim suit?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, stick with what works! I think it's lovely!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Now you just have to do your makeup and hair, and we'll be set to go.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh, I haven't actually done makeup or hair stuff before...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Really? Didn't your mom or someone teach you?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's not really something that my family does...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, don't worry about it. I brought my makeup kit over. I have a purple eyeshadow that'll look amazing on you!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: And I have some jewelry that you can wear with your dress.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Wow, you guys... That's so... Nice. This is such a surprise.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We haven't even gotten to the surprise part. Now do you want a gold or silver bracelet?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Silver, please.
Hannah and Linda help Sara get ready.
A couple hours later...
They arrive at the dance in full swing!
Some students dance to Top Forty songs, while others stand near the snack table and eat.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Wow, this is so amazing!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Looks like every other dance we go to...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: But I guess it is `kind of` nicer than normal.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I guess it is [color=#3b78e2][i]kind of[/i][/color] nicer than normal.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's cool how they set up the stage for Homecoming Queen. And they have a live band for us this year!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Want to go dance?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah!
Sara, Linda, and Hannah party on the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: This is really fun!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Your dad should be happy... It's like getting extra exercise.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Maybe I should try to convince him dancing is more beneficial than weight-lifting...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh yeah, that'll go over well.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Hey, don't look now, but your biggest fan is coming over.
Sara looks where Hannah is pointing and sees Erik Ericson approaching.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Can I have this dance?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Are you talking to me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Of course! You're the Queen of the Sea! So what do you say?
Sara looks at Linda and Hannah and whispers to both of them.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Whatever you want.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Don't be so serious. It's not like you're going to make out with him.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Whoa, I've never danced with a `boy` before! What do I say?
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa, I've never danced with a [color=#3b78e2][i]boy[/i][/color] before! What do I say?

nodes.text: Sara turns to Erik.
An awkward silence falls over the group.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, anyone want to dance? Amanda and I are going to dance. Come on, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hey, Maria and I are going with you!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Count me and Jessica in too!
Nicole looks from the dance floor to Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You want to dance too, Nicole?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Actually, I just want to make out with that hot guy over by the snack table...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Make out with whoever you want.
Taylor sullenly watches everyone leave her. She takes the nearest chair and glares out at the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't care that I have no date, I don't care that everyone left me... I don't care about `anything at all!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't care that I have no date, I don't care that everyone left me... I don't care about [color=#3b78e2][i]anything at all![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Talk bubbles around her, and Taylor can catch snippets of conversation. To Taylor's right...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: So who'd you vote for Queen?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You know I don't care about this stuff.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Doesn't mean you didn't vote.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: $ZOE. She's the only one I didn't hate.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah, me too.
And to Taylor's left...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It was pretty easy to figure out who to vote for... $ZOE is one of the nicer girls here. She deserves it, I think.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I think so too.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Besides Howard is Homecoming King. I want them to be together.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know, I was almost a Homecoming King...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, you'll just have to settle for being my Homecoming Prince.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is everyone voting for $ZOE?! Does no one like me? Am I not popular?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I can't breathe... I need... I need... Air!
Taylor runs outside...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sometimes I don't think they fear me enough! Voting for $ZOE `and` me?! What were they thinking?
nodes.text_bbcode: Sometimes I don't think they fear me enough! Voting for $ZOE [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] me?! What were they thinking?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Are you actually asking me? Or is that a rhetorical question?
Taylor looks over and sees Brendan sitting on a stair.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're awfully hidden. What are you doing out here?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Too much was going on inside. I got overwhelmed, so I came out here to breathe.
Taylor sits down next to him.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Tell me about it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, I came with the nerds because Erik had a big date with some girl and was nervous, so he kept asking me for girl advice...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I kept trying to give it, but it was hard to give relationship advice when... When... Well, I

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: When I said 'tell me about it', I didn't mean 'spill your guts', Brendan. But sorry about that whole Dinah thing.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Breakups suck.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, they really do. I just can't believe she moved on that quickly. How will I move on?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm sure someone smart like you will figure it out...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thanks... But enough about that. What's your evening been like?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Honestly? It's been a disaster. I don't know if I'm going to win Homecoming Queen, and getting this crown means `everything...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Honestly? It's been a disaster. I don't know if I'm going to win Homecoming Queen, and getting this crown means [color=#3b78e2][i]everything...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Or at least, I `thought` it meant a lot.
nodes.text_bbcode: Or at least, I [color=#3b78e2][i]thought[/i][/color] it meant a lot.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know, when I was just starting out at Centerscore, I thought being popular was what I wanted...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I wonder if I was happier before...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now that I'm here, I'm just so tired of everything. Boys still dump you, and your friends are as fake as the sugar in the punch. The cheerleaders only voted for me because they're afraid of me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm at the top of the heap, today's supposed to be my crowning moment, and I'm not even enjoying it. In fact, the only part of tonight I've enjoyed so far has been talking to `you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm at the top of the heap, today's supposed to be my crowning moment, and I'm not even enjoying it. In fact, the only part of tonight I've enjoyed so far has been talking to [color=#3b78e2][i]you![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, thanks... I don't think I did anything special...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You've been nice enough to listen.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Anytime.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know what's crazy? I've been surrounded by people all day... But you're the first person I feel like I've actually talked to.
Brendan leans forward.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I like talking to you, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's crazy... But I like talking to you too.
Taylor leans toward Brendan. A romantic song drifts out from the gym.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So... Did you come with anyone?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No. You?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No.
Taylor holds Brendan's gaze for a long time. Then, she leans forward to...
Sam answers the door. Spencer stands on the porch, holding a box of flowers. He offers it to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt brought me flowers on our first date...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: These are for you. And, uh, you look nice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, thanks?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I remember going on my first date with Colt... On the back of his motorcycle...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And having to do my hair when I got back so Whitford wouldn't catch me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I used to be so happy with Colt... What happened? And where is he right now?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And what is that burning smell?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `My hair!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]My hair![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam sets the curling iron down and tosses water on her hair!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I have to focus! I wonder if I have enough time to...
The doorbell rings...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess I'll just go with straight hair tonight...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Straight and vaguely burned.

We know what happened with the Princesses, but what about Ben? How did he get to the dance with Denni?
A couple days earlier, before the Homecoming Game...
I hope you don't find this to be too weird, but since you're a Homecoming Prince and all, I have to interview you.
I don't mind. Ask away.
What three words would you use to describe yourself?
Tall, dark, handsome?
Stretching the truth already? You know you're on record, right?
Hey! Which part of that is untrue?
Oh, I don't know, all of it?
You're hurting my feelings here.
Maybe you're a little handsome. But only a little.
Uh-huh.
But seriously, I think the three words that describe me are...
Relaxed, fun-loving, and rebellious.
Really?
Yeah, really. Why not?
It's the 'fun-loving' part, isn't it?
No, it's not that. I just thought one of them might have been devoted or dedicated or something...
Don't those both mean the same thing?
You know what I mean. You always try to excel, you always get A's, and you had the initiative to start the Science Club...
A lot has changed in the last few weeks. I'm a different person now.
I hope this doesn't change what you think about me...
I can be nerdier if you like.
Ha ha, I'm okay with a more fun-loving, relaxed, rebellious Ben.
All right, next question. What would you say is your best quality?
I would say it's my intellect. I'm clever, and I can figure my way out of any situation.
I wouldn't say that's your `best` quality...
Oh yeah?
Well, you're also thoughtful and kind of sweet.
You can feel free to put all that down...
Ha. Okay, next question...
Since you pulled off that prank at Wilson, some people believe you're a hero.
What would you say is the biggest change in your life as a result?
Other than a renewed interest in school spirit and school pride...
I'd have to say the best result is getting the attention of all the girls.
Oh, really? What's so great about that?
Well, I think it's given me the confidence to ask out the girl I really want.
Denni, will you go to the Homecoming Dance with me?
As in, like a date?
Well, I know you're sorting things out, so it doesn't have to be...
Maybe we can just go out as friends and see how it goes?
Thank you, Ben... And I'd love to go with you.

And across the city, four girls are just waking up...
At her house, Taylor stands in front of the glass case that holds her two crowns.

While across town, Sara eats her 1500-calorie breakfast and prepares for morning training.

nodes.speaker: Sara

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sara!
Sara steps forward, stunned.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's... It's really me?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Congratulations! You're our new Homecoming Queen!
All the students break into applause as Justin places the crown on Sara's head.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: There you have it! The Homecoming Royal Couple will participate in a Homecoming Kiss before they lead the dance!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Like, a real kiss? On the mouth? Isn't that a little awkward?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's tradition.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, I'm changing tradition.
Sara kisses Howard on the cheek.

nodes.text: And now for the dance...
Howard leads Sara out onto the dance floor. They sway to the song.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I can't believe I'm up here. I never thought I'd get enough votes... Not when I was busy with swimming practice and my routine...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Of course I couldn't do it without Erik and the swim team, but...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's what friends are for, right?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Right. But being crowned Queen... It just makes me feel like I really can become an Olympic swimmer `and` have the kind of social life I want!
nodes.text_bbcode: Right. But being crowned Queen... It just makes me feel like I really can become an Olympic swimmer [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] have the kind of social life I want!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I have to thank everyone for helping me get the votes, and the crown, and... And...

nodes.speaker: Howard

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh! I forgot all about that... I hope my dad will let me go...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll figure something out.

nodes.speaker: Sara

nodes.speaker: Sara

nodes.speaker: Sara

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.text: I remember that. How'd you get over it?

nodes.text: I broke up with him and vowed to never see him again.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did it work?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not at first, but after a little while, I felt better. It helps that he hasn't been around.

nodes.text: Well, I don't want to break up with $ZOE. I mean, we weren't even together when she started hanging out with Matteo...

nodes.speaker: Howard
