nodes.text: It's also like I can't un-see them kiss.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what are you going to do about it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nothing. Deal with it, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, that's probably the best thing to do. But having your boyfriend cheat on you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't you ever wonder if you should try to get revenge?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ha, who would I even try kissing?
Sam meets Howard's gaze, and they stare at each other for one long moment...
And burst out laughing!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No way `that's` happening!
nodes.text_bbcode: No way [color=#3b78e2][i]that's[/i][/color] happening!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Definitely not. Want to go inside and watch a movie?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Only if it's a scary zombie film.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Perfect.
Sounds like Sam's having fun on her vacation! Thank you to everyone who had a hand in electing her Queen!
See you next time on Surviving High School!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sam!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah! Go Samwich!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Samwich, really? You're letting him call you that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah! Go Samface!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Samface, really? You're letting him call you that?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Yes!` The Triple Crown is `mine!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yes![/i][/color] The Triple Crown is [color=#3b78e2][i]mine![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Taylor gets on stage and takes the crown from Justin! She turns to the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I expected you all to vote for me, and you did! Thank you!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: There you have it! The Homecoming Royal Couple will participate in the traditional Homecoming Kiss before they lead the dance!
Taylor gives Howard a quick kiss.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Now for the dance...
Howard leads Taylor onto the dance floor, and they sway to the music.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So... Congratulations, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is, like, the best day ever! I've been working towards the Triple Crown my whole life...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You don't know how many other girls' dreams I had to step on to get this... And now I have it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, you must be pretty happy.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I totally am!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But if that's what you've been working for your entire life, what are you going to do next?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh, I hadn't really thought of that. I've been dreaming about this day for so long...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Me having the Triple Crown, being the most popular girl at school, captaining the cheerleading team...
Over Howard's shoulder, Taylor's eyes meet Brendan's.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't know what's going to happen next, but I have a feeling it's going to be fun...
As Taylor enjoys her dance with Howard, the other Princesses all react differently to their loss...
On the stage, $ZOE's heart sinks as she watches Howard dance with Taylor.
Congratulations to Taylor for winning Homecoming Queen! Let's check in a few days later on Howard and Taylor's tropical vacation!
On a beach far, far away...
Taylor drags Howard to some shops on beach row.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: More shopping? We've been here the entire day, and all we've done is shop.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I happen to like shopping. What's the point of going on vacation?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Relaxing on the beach?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's fine if you want to shop, but can't I at least do something else? I'll just be on that beach towel over there...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I need someone to carry my bags, Howard. That's why you're here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Taylor, you're strong and independent. You don't need me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you don't carry my bags, I'm going to tell $ZOE that we made out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But we haven't...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: 'Oh, $ZOE, I don't even know how it happened. It must've been the salty beach air!'

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: 'One minute we were just talking, and the next... He kissed me!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, wait just a minute...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: '$ZOE, I can see why you wanted to keep him. He's such a `great` kisser!'
nodes.text_bbcode: '$ZOE, I can see why you wanted to keep him. He's such a [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color] kisser!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you seriously blackmailing me into carrying all your bags?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, if you're good, you can also buy me dinner later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Can we at least have dinner on the beach?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll think about it...
At least `Taylor` is having fun on her vacation! Thank you to everyone who had a hand in electing her Queen!
nodes.text_bbcode: At least [b]Taylor[/b] is having fun on her vacation! Thank you to everyone who had a hand in electing her Queen!

nodes.text: See you next time on Surviving High School!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Congratulations, $ZOE. If I couldn't be queen, then I'm glad it's you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you, Sam.
$ZOE steps forward and stands next to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey yourself.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: There you have it! The Homecoming Royal Couple will participate in the traditional Homecoming Kiss before they lead the dance!
$ZOE and Howard kiss quickly, then pull away.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Congratulations, you two! Now for the dance...
Howard leads $ZOE onto the dance floor as the music picks up. They sway to the music.
An awkward, angry silence hangs between them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you still mad?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You sound mad.
Another silence. $ZOE can't hear the music over the blood pounding in her ears.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Congratulations on being Queen, I guess. Isn't that what you really wanted?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I only wanted to win so that I could be up here with you. I didn't want you to kiss another girl!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And what about Matteo?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're not being fair. We were broken up when I kissed him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wasn't that a little quick to replace me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He never would have replaced you, Howard! You mean so much to me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I already told you I'm not the one that's been contacting him. He just wants to make sure I'm okay.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's what was in his email. And I deleted it. `And` the text message. For you.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's what was in his email. And I deleted it. [color=#3b78e2][i]And[/i][/color] the text message. For you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What I mean by all this is... I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry too. I'm sorry for getting angry and yelling and making you come alone. I love you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you too.
As $ZOE dances with Howard, the other Princesses all react differently to their loss...
In the dance hall, Taylor tastes the bitterness of defeat as she watches the crown sparkling on top of $ZOE's head.
Congratulations to $ZOE for winning Homecoming Queen! Let's check in a few days later on Howard and $ZOE's tropical vacation!
At an oceanside, Italian-themed resort, Howard and $ZOE are wandering around the beach and stopping at food shacks when Howard hears...

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Hey, signorina!
Howard's head whips around, and he sees an Italian man standing in front of a restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Wait up, signorina! Come over and have a fine pasta!

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: No, over here, signorina!
Howard whips his head around again.

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: What about some fries?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gah!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, what are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Where?!` Where is he?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Where?![/i][/color] Where is he?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who are you looking for?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Matteo! I keep hearing 'signorina this' or 'signorina that'!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, 'signorina' is the term for 'miss'! Matteo's not the only one who uses it. Everyone at a fake Italian hotel would!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Besides, Matteo's in `France!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Besides, Matteo's in [color=#3b78e2][i]France![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, good point.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now will you relax? We're here together, alone, and I want to enjoy the rest of the day!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Signorina, a lovely purse over here!
Howard's head whips around for the source of the voice.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's a woman.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're right. I'll focus more on us.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now let's go check out that hat stand over there!
Sounds like $ZOE's at least trying to have fun on her vacation! Thank you to everyone who had a hand in electing her Queen!
See you next time on Surviving High School!
